message.content: [虚假诉讼罪; 伪造文书罪]<eoa>
message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts: The defendant Guo used false loan amounts, forged loan notes, colluded with Shen to have borrowers sue him for inflated amounts, causing the court to make false mediation. This is likely "诈骗罪" (fraud) because he obtained money by false pretenses? Actually he is the defendant being sued? He induced others to sue him for larger amounts, causing false mediation. This could be "伪证罪" (perjury) or "虚假诉讼罪" (false litigation). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime of "虚假诉讼罪" (Article 313 of Criminal Law) for fabricating false claims in civil or administrative litigation. Also "伪造文书罪" (forgery of documents) for forging loan notes. Also "诈骗罪" if he obtained money by deception. Here he is causing false mediation, likely false litigation. So crimes: 虚假诉讼罪; 伪造文书罪. Possibly also "敲诈勒索罪"? No. So answer: [虚假诉讼罪; 伪造文书罪]<eoa>.
